display.label: AWS Route Table
display.description: Provision an Amazon VPC Route Table, its routes, and its subnet or gateway associations

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique identifier for this route table, applied as its 'Name' tag.

fields.label: Route Table Name
fields.description: Unique name for the route table, applied as the 'Name' tag and map key.

validation.pattern_error: Name must only contain alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores.

fields.label: VPC
fields.description: The VPC in which to create the route table.

fields.label: Subnets
fields.description: Subnets to associate with this route table. Mutually exclusive with Gateway (edge association) below -- AWS allows either subnet associations or a single gateway association, not both.

fields.label: Gateway (Edge Association)
fields.description: For edge/ingress routing: associate this route table directly with an Internet Gateway or Virtual Private Gateway instead of subnets. No lookup is wired here, since a gateway could be either type and only Internet Gateways and NAT Gateways are created elsewhere in this catalog today -- enter the Gateway ID directly (e.g. igw-... or vgw-...).

fields.label: Propagating Virtual Private Gateways
fields.description: Virtual Private Gateway IDs whose routes should propagate into this route table. No lookup is wired here, since this catalog does not yet create Virtual Private Gateways -- enter VGW IDs directly.

sections.label: Routes
sections.description: Routes to create in this route table. Each must specify exactly one destination and exactly one target.

fields.label: Key
fields.description: Terraform-only identifier for this route, not sent to AWS.

fields.label: Destination IPv4 CIDR
fields.description: Give exactly one destination: an IPv4 CIDR, an IPv6 CIDR, or a managed prefix list.

fields.label: Destination Prefix List ID
fields.description: An AWS-managed or customer-managed prefix list ID. No lookup is wired here, since this catalog does not yet create prefix lists -- enter the ID directly.

fields.label: Internet / Virtual Private Gateway
fields.description: Give exactly one target. No lookup is wired here, since a gateway could be an Internet Gateway, Virtual Private Gateway, or other edge type not yet created elsewhere in this catalog -- enter the ID directly.

fields.label: Transit Gateway
fields.description: No lookup is wired here, since this catalog does not yet create Transit Gateways -- enter the ID directly.

fields.label: Gateway VPC Endpoint
fields.description: No lookup is wired here yet -- enter the VPC Endpoint ID directly.

fields.label: Network Interface (ENI)
fields.description: No lookup is wired here, since this catalog does not yet create standalone network interfaces -- enter the ENI ID directly.

fields.label: Egress-Only Internet Gateway
fields.description: No lookup is wired here, since this catalog does not yet create Egress-Only Internet Gateways -- enter the ID directly.

fields.label: Carrier Gateway
fields.description: No lookup is wired here, since this catalog does not yet create Carrier Gateways -- enter the ID directly.

fields.label: Local Gateway (Outposts)
fields.description: No lookup is wired here, since this catalog does not yet create Local Gateways -- enter the ID directly.

fields.label: Cloud WAN Core Network ARN
fields.description: No lookup is wired here, since this catalog does not yet create Cloud WAN Core Networks -- enter the ARN directly.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: User-defined key-value tags to assign to the route table.
